notes.title: Major Update #2 - Migrated the game to a newer engine version
notes.content: [p][b]We’ve finally migrated the game to a newer engine version. Thanks to this, [i]nircmd[/i] and the extra executable file are no longer needed to run the game on 10th-gen Intel CPUs and newer.[/b][/p][p][b]In addition, a series of fixes have been implemented that were applied in the Early Access version. Examples below: [/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Day-Night Cycle & Random Weather Variation[/h3][list][*][p]Added a dynamic weather system with snow and fog.[/p][/*][*][p]Added snowflake effects on the locomotive’s front windows during snowfall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the sun’s movement across the sky, improving sunrise and sunset positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted day-night lighting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Significantly improved performance of the Measurement Apparatus illumination.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimised Buffer Lights and flashlights.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall lighting performance.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the glass could clip into the camera while drinking at the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of navigation-system-related crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]And much more. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If you haven't already, we encourage you to purchase early access, which is constantly being developed. The full route from Novosibirsk to Krasnoyarsk - approximately 840 kilometers - is already completed! Thank you for your support![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/998400/TransSiberian_Railway_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="38SMZ9u2zbU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update #1 - A series of fixes
notes.content:
[b]A series of fixes have been implemented that were applied in the Early Access version.
The old game saves unfortunately will not work. [/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed stuttering caused by the skylight refreshing every second.
[*]Added a mini-map.
[*]Reduced the rate at which locomotive parts break down. 
[*]Changed the currency to rubles. 
[*]Added more NPCs who can shoot and run, and some standing NPCs were changed to running ones. 
[*]Fixed many bugs with game saves.
[*]Improved the locomotive pressure system.
[*]Improved the lighting of the second locomotive.
[*]Most switches on the second panel are now unlocked and can be changed regardless of where the key is in the locomotive.
[*]Increased the maximum locomotive speed to 100 km/h.
[*]Added NPCs that can buy weapons.
[*]Reduced waypoints size.
[*]Added a backlight to the speedometer.
[*]Fixed a bug with flashlight zooming.
[*]And much more. Basically, everything that was improved in the Early Access version and relates to the prologue has been added to it.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for checking out the prologue and for all the positive reviews. We encourage you to purchase the full version of the game, where we've recently added over 200 km of new routes![/b]
